reason: General cargo may include chemical/industrial goods with unknown residues — grain surveyor requires hold history disclosure; unknown cargo chemistry fails grain-clean inspection by default (fail-closed per broker note)

General cargo (project, bagged, palletised) leaves no chemical contamination; holds require normal clean + hospital-clean standard before steel coils — achievable from general prior; symmetric with steel→general
No chemical residue from general cargo; hospital clean achievable; threaded-end contamination risk absent if prior general was dry goods — surveyor pre-inspection standard applies
Iron ore is low contamination-sensitive for loading; general cargo leaves no chemical residue incompatible with iron oxides; normal clean sufficient

DRI requires inert atmosphere (N2) and zero moisture/organic residue; general cargo composition unknown — packaging material, organic goods or moisture-retaining goods risk H2 generation and self-heating in DRI; manual surveyor review required
Coal is not contamination-sensitive for loading; general cargo leaves no residue incompatible with coal chemistry; normal clean acceptable; symmetric with coal→general
Petcoke is not contamination-sensitive for loading (it contaminates others, not vice versa); general cargo residue does not affect petcoke chemistry; normal clean acceptable

Fertilizer (especially AN-based) requires hospital clean; general cargo may include incompatible oxidiser-adjacent goods or packaging contaminants; unknown hold history fails fertilizer surveyor requirement — manual surveyor review required
Cement is not degraded by general cargo residues (no organic acids, no sugars assumed); normal clean acceptable; alkaline cement tolerant of minor mixed-cargo trace residues
Sulphur loading not contamination-sensitive to general cargo residues; dry general cargo leaves no moisture-generating residue that would trigger sulphuric acid formation; normal clean acceptable

Scrap metal is not contamination-sensitive for loading; general cargo residues compatible with ferrous scrap; normal clean sufficient — surveyor inspection for scrap quality is shipper obligation, not prior-cargo dependent
Bauxite loading not sensitive to general cargo residues; no chemical incompatibility between aluminium oxide ore and typical mixed/project cargo; normal clean acceptable

Sugar requires grain-clean equivalent; general cargo may include alkaline, chemical or odour-generating goods — sugar is highly reactive to alkaline residues and susceptible to odour transfer; unknown cargo history fails sugar surveyor inspection (fail-closed)

Salt (industrial grade) tolerant of general cargo residues; normal clean + fresh water rinse sufficient; food-grade sea salt requires surveyor pre-inspection — conditional on actual prior general cargo type
Limestone is chemically inert and not contamination-sensitive for loading; general cargo leaves no residue incompatible with CaCO3; normal clean acceptable; symmetric with limestone→general
Manganese ore not contamination-sensitive to prior general cargo; no chemical incompatibility; normal clean acceptable; TML certificate is shipper obligation independent of prior cargo

Copper concentrate requires dedicated voyage per broker standard; dual-hazard cargo (Group A liquefaction + Group B H2S/arsenic) requires certified clean holds with no unknown residues; general cargo history unknown — manual surveyor review required
